title: Aging study on twenty A123 18650 Graphite/LFP 1.1 Ah cells
protocol: C/25 discharge and charge pseudo-OCV characterization every 100 ageing cycles
processing: At each measured checkpoint, SOC is normalized by that checkpoint capacity and pOCV is the pointwise mean of the measured C/25 discharge and charge voltages. No SOH-to-voltage decay formula is used.
